Update for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric, on Linux, Windows and macOS).

### New

- **Tilt and Float up.** With the **World** layout, two new sliders in **Lyrics → Position**: **Tilt** sets how much the floating words turn and lean (from facing you straight on to twice the usual), and **Float up** sets how far they drift upward while they hang in the air (from staying put to twice as far).
- **Distance works in World.** The **Distance** slider now moves the floating words closer or farther (half to twice the usual), and farther words grow so they stay just as easy to read. The **Height** slider, which did nothing there, is hidden for World.
- **Elytra mode does more.** Besides gliding, it now carries the words while you ride a boat, minecart or horse and while you fly in creative.

### Fixed

- **Lyrics behind water, ice and glass.** Without a shader pack, words seen through water, ice or glass no longer vanish or cut holes in them.
- **Elytra mode keeps up with you.** The words turn with you while you steer, new words appear where you're looking even if you picked a fixed World direction, and a lag spike mid-flight no longer leaves them behind.
- **Wide field of view.** With a high FOV, words near the edge of the screen are no longer cut off early.

### Faster

- **Words you can't see cost nothing.** Floating words that are just off screen are skipped.
- **Lighter glow on Light effects.** With **Effects** on **Light** (or **Auto** when frames drop), only the words being sung keep their glow, so a full line costs far less.
